actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Seed of the environment's random generator
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

actions.description: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.

inputs.description: Seed used by the next reset
inputs.name: seed

facts.text: The REALRobot environment is a standard gym environment with a 7DoF Kuka arm, a 2DoF gripper and a table with 3 objects
The action is a vector of 9 joint positions in radians; the two gripper joints range from 0 to +pi/2 and are coupled so the second is at most twice the first
The environment registers 18 REALRobot2020 ids and creates them through real_robots.envs:REALRobotEnv with additional_obs, objects and action_type keyword arguments
REALRobotEnv defaults to render=False, objects=3, action_type='joints' and additional_obs=True
With action_type='joints' the action space is a Dict with 'joint_command' (the 9-joint Box) and 'render' (MultiBinary(1))
Kuka builds a 9-element Box action space from min_joints and max_joints; the two gripper joints are limited to 0 and pi/2
Each step clamps the change of a joint to at most 0.2 rad for joints 1 to 5, 0.3 rad for joints 6 and 7 and 0.1 rad for the two gripper joints
step_joints applies the joint command, advances the Bullet scene and returns (observation, reward, done, info)
The default reward function returns 0 for every observation
The intrinsic phase ends after 15e6 steps and an extrinsic trial after 10e3 steps
step_joints sets done when the timestep reaches intrinsic_timesteps or extrinsic_timesteps
The observation dictionary carries joint_positions, touch_sensors, retina and goal, and the extended form adds depth, mask, object_positions, goal_mask and goal_positions
The top camera image and the goal image are 240x320x3 arrays
Kuka has 9 joints, 4 touch sensors and a 320 by 240 eye camera
The observation space declares joint_positions, touch_sensors, retina, depth, goal and, with additional_obs, mask, object_positions, goal_mask and goal_positions with the Kuka dimensions
The Bullet scene uses gravity 9.81, a timestep of 0.005 s and frame_skip 1
reset resets the simulation, sets gravity to (0, 0, -9.81), resets the timestep to 0 and returns the observation
The installation requires gym, pybullet and numpy (plus Click, tqdm, aicrowd-api, pillow and pyinterval); it declares no serial, VISA or socket dependency

determinism.notes: the fake accepts reset(seed=...) and uses the seed for its synthetic tabletop object positions; the upstream REALRobotEnv.reset() takes no seed (env.py:206) and the upstream PyBullet path would not reproduce that seed, so only the fake is seeded

gaps: kinematic stand-in for the PyBullet model: no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, friction, object physics or rendered camera; joint positions follow the commanded targets with the upstream per-step clamp (env.py:314-321)

the retina, depth, mask and goal arrays are 24x32 (three channels for images) instead of the device's 240x320x3 and 240x320 (robot.py:30-31,86-95); their values are synthetic test data, not camera or sensor readings

the fake accepts reset(seed, options) and seeds its synthetic object positions; the upstream REALRobotEnv.reset() takes no seed (env.py:206), so the upstream PyBullet path does not reproduce the fake's seeded trajectories
the fake returns zero goal_mask and goal_positions arrays; the upstream extended observation carries goal.mask and goal.final_state, which are None until a goal is set (env.py:97-98,307-309)
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, and ticks advance simulated time by timestep_ms only
snapshot and restore are not offered: REALRobotEnv has no get_state/set_state
no physical device is modelled and the model was never validated against one
the fake was never compared with the upstream environment: gym and pybullet are not installed where the gate runs (setup.py:24-31)

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the last observation stays readable
